title: Petal Panic v1 — Run-and-Gun Demo
why: Build a playable, tuned v1 demo of the Petal Panic side-scrolling run-and-gun: one level, two heroes, six enemies, powerups, and the Overgrown Elephant boss, on a solid collision/physics foundation.
outcomes: Playable HTML5 canvas game with correct feel; strong AABB collision + entity architecture; debug/test harness for fast tuning; stats telemetry for balance.

milestones.name: Engine Foundation
pattern: Fixed-timestep loop, Entity base class, layer/mask collision
milestones.objective: Core render+update loop, Entity base struct, AABB collision with layer masks, and camera — the load-bearing foundation.
milestones.success: A colored box moves on screen under fixed 60Hz physics, collides with a solid platform, and the camera follows it; debug overlay draws boxes.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Input] --> B[Integrate physics]
  B --> C[CollisionWorld.update]
  C --> D[Resolve solids + hit callbacks]
  D --> E[Camera follow]
  E --> F[Render + debug overlay]

tasks.name: Game loop + canvas scaffold
tasks.what: Create project scaffold (index.html, main.js, module layout) with a fixed 60Hz accumulator loop and canvas render.
tasks.why: Deterministic physics independent of refresh rate; clean module structure for all later systems.
acceptance: Canvas renders at stable 60Hz physics steps
Module files exist and load without errors

tasks.name: Entity base + transform
tasks.what: Implement Entity base class with full transform (x,y,w,h,facing,mirrorX/Y,rotation,scale,vx,vy,gravity), anim ref, layer mask, alive.
tasks.why: Single source of truth for position+look; every other entity inherits this.
acceptance: Entity exposes worldBox() from offset box
mirrorX derives from facing when set

tasks.name: AABB collision + layer masks
tasks.what: Build CollisionWorld with spatial-hash broadphase, aabbOverlap, resolve() for solids, and declarative layer/mask pair testing.
tasks.why: Scales to 6 enemies + boss + projectiles without if-chain spaghetti; new interaction = one mask line.
acceptance: aabbOverlap correct incl. edge/touch cases
resolve() prevents pass-through of SOLID
Adding a new pair requires only a mask entry

tasks.name: Camera + debug overlay
tasks.what: Add hero-following camera clamped to level bounds with facing look-ahead, and the F3 debug overlay (colored boxes).
tasks.why: Side-scroll framing is core feel; debug boxes are needed before any tuning.
snippet:
// camera.js
function updateCam(cam,hero,len){ cam.x=clamp(hero.x-cam.w/2+hero.facing*80, 0, len-cam.w); }
acceptance: Camera clamps to [0,length]
Debug overlay draws orange/green/red/blue/pink boxes

milestones.name: Hero Movement
milestones.objective: One hero runs, jumps (non-looping synced rotation), crouches/slides, and mirrors on facing — the feel-critical slice.
milestones.success: Selected hero moves fluidly: run/jump/crouch/slide feel good, jump anim rotates takeoff->landing without looping, sprite flips on direction change.
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  Idle --> Run : move input
  Run --> Jump : jump
  Jump --> Run : land
  Run --> Crouch : down
  Crouch --> Slide : move while crouch
  Crouch --> Run : release down

tasks.name: Animation engine
tasks.what: Implement the anim controller (frames, frameSpeed, loop, pickFrame) with transform read from Entity; support non-looping one-shot anims.
tasks.why: Clean animation is required for jump sync, melee active-frame, death fade, invincibility blink.
acceptance: Looping anim cycles; non-looping stops at last frame
pickFrame(n) overrides current frame

tasks.name: Hero class + movement
tasks.what: Implement Hero (wraps a hero def) with run/jump/crouch/slide, gravity, ground friction, facing+mirrorX, and crouch box shrink.
tasks.why: Core playable character; crouch box shrink validates the offset-box collision model.
snippet:
// hero.js
class Hero extends Entity{ update(input,world){ /* integrate vx/vy, gravity, friction; set facing/mirrorX; swap crouch box */ } }
acceptance: Jump impulse matches hero.jump stat; lands on SOLID
Crouch shrinks collision box (verified in debug overlay)
Sprite mirrors when facing left

tasks.name: State machine skeleton
tasks.what: Implement the top-level state enum + transition dispatcher (home/select/play/pause/gameover/win) as a thin skeleton; actual screen rendering is built in the Screens & HUD milestone.
tasks.why: Gives every system a single place to read/write game state and route input, without coupling to screen visuals.
tasks.acceptance: State transitions are central and testable; screens plug in later

milestones.name: Combat Core
pattern: Projectile pool, melee hitbox window, damage routing
milestones.objective: Hero shoots 8-way thorns, swings melee with an active-frame hitbox, and a jester enemy takes damage and dies — combat loop proven end to end.
milestones.success: Hero can kill a jester with projectiles and melee; friendly-fire off; enemy projectile hits hero; death anim + sparkle + coin drop play.

tasks.name: Projectiles + 8-way shooting
tasks.what: Implement Projectile (pooled) with 8-direction aim from facing, ammo cost, projectile_freq cooldown, lifetime cull, friendly flag.
tasks.why: Contra-style shooting is the core verb; pooling keeps perf safe under caps.
acceptance: Shots fire in 8 directions toward aim
Ammo decrements; no fire at 0
Friendly projectiles never hit hero

tasks.name: Melee attack + damage routing
tasks.what: Add hero melee swing with active hitbox on the max attack frame, swing cooldown, and a central damage() that routes through defense into stats+effects.
tasks.why: Melee breaks barrels and kills close enemies; central damage() avoids scattered HP math.
snippet:
// damage.js
function damage(src,tgt,amt,method){ const real=Math.max(1,amt-tgt.stats.defense); tgt.energy-=real; src.stats.damageDealt.byMethod[method]+=real; /* effect */ }
acceptance: Melee only deals damage during active frame
damage() respects target defense and updates telemetry

tasks.name: Jester enemy + death pipeline
tasks.what: Implement Enemy base + Jester AI (walk/chase/whip), contact damage to hero, and the death pipeline (death anim -> fade -> sparkle -> coin drop).
tasks.why: First full enemy proves the AI contract, contact damage, and death VFX path others reuse.
snippet:
// jester.js
class Jester extends Enemy{ ai(dt){ /* idle/walk/chase/attack states; aggro radius */ } }
acceptance: Jester chases within aggro radius and whips when close
Contact drains hero energy
Death plays anim then sparkle + coin drop

milestones.name: World Objects
pattern: Solid objects, breakable barrels, pickups, coins with bounce physics
milestones.objective: Barrels block and break (explosion AoE), coin barrels burst into bouncing coins, powerups apply effects, checkpoints set restart — the level is interactive.
milestones.success: Hero can't pass barrels; melee/bomb breaks them with AoE damage; coins bounce to ground and are collected; powerups apply their documented effects; checkpoint enables restart.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Hero touches barrel] --> B{melee or bomb?}
  B -->|yes| C[break -> explosion AoE]
  C --> D[damage enemies + hero in radius]
  B -->|no| E[blocked]
  F[coin barrel break] --> G[spawn mixed coins]
  G --> H[coins fall + bounce on ground]

tasks.name: Objects: barrels + explosions
tasks.what: Implement Object base with destructible-solid barrel (blocks hero+enemy, has HP). Melee/projectile/bomb deal damage to barrel HP; it does NOT break on touch or per-hit. When HP hits 0 it explodes: AoE damage within explodeRadius to enemies and hero.
tasks.why: Barrels are core cover/hazard; AoE self-damage adds risk/reward.
acceptance: Hero and enemy cannot pass a barrel (solid)
Melee/projectile/bomb chip barrel HP; no explosion until HP=0
A bomb one-shots the barrel; thorns/melee need several hits
Explosion at HP=0 damages entities in radius including hero

tasks.name: Coins with bounce + collection
tasks.what: Implement Coin (per-type weight) that falls, bounces off ground/platforms, and is collected on hero touch; coin barrel bursts into mixed coins.
tasks.why: Coin physics is a named design requirement; collection feeds score + 1up threshold.
snippet:
// coin.js
class Coin extends Entity{ update(dt){ this.vy+=GRAVITY*this.weight; if(grounded) this.vy*=-0.4; } }
acceptance: Coins bounce with per-type weight differences
Coin barrel spawns several mixed coins
Collection increments stats.coinsCollected

tasks.name: Powerups + checkpoint
tasks.what: Implement Powerup pickup applying each documented effect (ammo, invincibility duration+blink, special box, rapid, shield, clear, energy, 1up) and Checkpoint setting restart position.
tasks.why: Powerups are the progression/fun loop; checkpoint enables the retry/continue flow.
snippet:
// powerup.js
const FX={ ammo:(p,v)=>p.ammo+=v, invincibility:p=>p.invincibleTimer=5, shield:p=>p.shield+=50, clear:killAllOnScreen, ... };
acceptance: Each powerup applies its §10 effect
Invincibility grants timed no-damage + fast blink
Checkpoint stores position used on death-restart

milestones.name: Full Roster + Level
pattern: Per-type AI state machines, level struct with random spawn
milestones.objective: All six enemy types implemented with distinct AI, assembled into one level (ground + air platforms, checkpoints 1-1..1-4, random rogue spawn).
milestones.success: A full level plays start-to-boss with all enemy behaviors distinct and fair; energy/lives/death/gameover flow works.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Level load] --> B[random spawn enemies/powerups/barrels]
  B --> C[hero traverses ground + platforms]
  C --> D{checkpoint?}
  D -->|hit| E[store restart pos]
  C --> F[energy 0 -> death -> lose life]
  F --> G{lives left?}
  G -->|no| H[gameover]

tasks.name: Remaining enemy AIs
tasks.what: Implement vine_hound, violetta_marionetta, jackolantern, boris_loon (+baby) with their §7 behaviors incl. flyer property and fake-idle from first walk frame.
tasks.why: Completes the roster; each AI is a small isolated state machine per the contract.
snippet:
// boris_loon.js (flyer)
class BorisLoon extends Enemy{ constructor(){ this.gravity=0; } ai(dt){ /* sine-wave hover, dive when player below */ } }
acceptance: Each type exhibits its documented behavior
Flyers ignore gravity; grounders do not
Enemies lacking idle use first walk frame statically

tasks.name: Energy / lives / gameover flow
tasks.what: Wire hero energy depletion, death (skull sine fade), life loss, respawn at checkpoint, and gameover with retry/continue(3)/quit.
tasks.why: Closes the survival loop so a full run can be lost and continued per design.
snippet: // on death: spawn skull effect (sine float+fade); lives--; if(lives>0) respawnAt(checkpoint) else state=OVER
acceptance: Death shows skull sine-wave fade
Respawn uses last checkpoint position only
Continue costs coins, limited to 3

tasks.name: Level struct + random spawn
tasks.what: Implement the level struct (name,index,boss,length,checkpoints,platforms, and a spawn budget: counts per enemy type, barrels, coinBarrels, powerups per type) plus a demo rogue spawner that randomly distributes those items along flat ground with min spacing, adding a few air platforms. Coins are NOT spawned directly — they come only from coin-barrel bursts and enemy death drops.
tasks.why: Makes the level data-driven and produces the v1 'rogue' layout for playtesting.
acceptance: Level loads with ground + air platforms
Checkpoints 1-1..1-4 placed along length
Rogue spawner places exactly the level.spawn counts of each item
Spawned items respect min spacing / no overlap
No loose coins spawned; coins only from coin barrels + enemy drops

milestones.name: Boss + Win
pattern: Boss phase state machine, camera lock
milestones.objective: Overgrown Elephant boss with telegraphed charge/stomp/trunk-blast phases, weak point, and win state on death.
milestones.success: Boss arena locks camera; phases are readable and dodgeable; defeating it triggers the win screen.
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  Idle --> Charge : trigger
  Charge --> Stomp : recover
  Stomp --> TrunkBlast : recover
  TrunkBlast --> Idle : recover
  Idle --> Death : hp 0
  Death --> Win

tasks.name: Elephant boss + win
tasks.what: Implement Boss (elephant) with HP, camera-lock arena, phase loop (charge/stomp/trunk_blast escalating with low HP), weak point, contact damage, and win state on death.
tasks.why: The level's climax; proves the boss pattern for the future 8-boss roadmap.
snippet:
// boss.js
class Elephant extends Enemy{ constructor(){ this.isBoss=true; } ai(dt){ /* phase machine; escalate speed/freq as hp drops */ } onDeath(){ state=WIN; } }
acceptance: Camera locks to boss arena during fight
Each phase is telegraphed and dodgeable
Trunk/head weak point takes bonus damage
Death triggers win state

milestones.name: Polish + Tuning Harness
pattern: Debug/test sandbox, effects, stats export, playtest tuning
milestones.objective: Full effect set, the F1 debug/test harness (spawn, god mode, slow-mo, anim scrubber, AI inspection), live stats HUD + export, and a tuning pass on feel/AI/difficulty.
milestones.success: All §12 effects play; F1 harness lets any entity be spawned/inspected/frame-scrubbed in seconds; stats dump to console/file at win/gameover; jump, enemy fairness, and difficulty are tuned via playtests.
milestones.diagram:
graph LR
  A[F1 harness] --> B[spawn / god / slow-mo]
  A --> C[anim scrubber + box overlay]
  A --> D[AI state force + aggro viz]
  E[win/gameover] --> F[dumpStats -> console/file]
  F --> G[tune feel/AI/difficulty]

tasks.name: Effects + particles
tasks.what: Implement all §12 effects: hero damage vignette, enemy shake/flash, death sparkle+fade, barrel break/explosion VFX, checkpoint flash, invincibility blink, pickup pop, red hit sparkles.
tasks.why: Juice makes hits and deaths read clearly; several are already required by combat/world tasks.
snippet:
// effects.js
function spawnSparkle(x,y,size){...} function vignette(intensity){...} function floatText(x,y,str){...}
acceptance: Each §12 effect triggers on its event
Enemy death fades fast while sparkle sized to sprite plays

tasks.name: Debug/test harness (F1)
tasks.what: Build the Debug module: free-spawn any entity in a chosen state, god mode, slow-mo/freeze, hero swap, AI-state force + aggro/facing viz, anim frame scrubber with box overlay, live stats HUD, event log.
tasks.why: Cuts tuning time dramatically — test any bat/clown/hero/powerup in seconds without playing the real game.
snippet:
// debug.js
const Debug={ enabled:false, spawn(type,state,x,y){...}, god:false, slowmo:1, selected:null, log:[] };
acceptance: Any enemy/boss/powerup/barrel spawns at cursor in a chosen state
Anim scrubber steps frames and overlays the collision box
AI state can be forced; aggro radius + label drawn
Live stats HUD reflects §4.1 telemetry

tasks.name: Stats export + tuning pass
tasks.what: Add dumpStats() serializing §4.1 to console/file at win/gameover, then run playtests to tune jump feel, per-enemy fairness (via damageDealt-byEnemy vs kills), powerup values, and difficulty.
tasks.why: Turns telemetry into a balance tool; the tuning pass is where the game actually gets made.
snippet:
// stats.js
function dumpStats(p){ const o={...p.stats}; console.table(o.damageDealt.byEnemy); downloadJSON(o); }
acceptance: Stats dump to console + downloadable JSON on win/gameover
Jump arc/feel validated via slow-mo + playtest
Per-enemy effective HP reviewed and tuned

milestones.name: Screens & HUD
milestones.objective: All game screens (home, select, pause, gameover, win) wired to the state machine with their assets and interactions, plus a functional HUD over Play.
milestones.success: Full flow plays: animated home -> hero select -> play (with readable HUD) -> pause/gameover/win screens all work with correct options and transitions.
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  Home --> Select : Enter
  Select --> Play : confirm hero
  Play --> Pause : Esc
  Pause --> Play : resume
  Pause --> Home : quit
  Play --> GameOver : lives 0
  Play --> Win : boss dead
  GameOver --> Play : retry/continue
  Win --> Select : play again

tasks.name: Home + Select screens
tasks.what: Implement Home (parallax bigtop + logo, Enter to continue) and Select (two hero panels, focus + confirm drives active Hero def) using the home_* and select_* assets.
tasks.why: Entry flow into the game; establishes the Screen-per-state pattern for all other screens.
acceptance: Home shows animated bigtop + logo; Enter goes to Select
Select focuses between the two heroes; confirm starts Play with that hero's stats

tasks.name: Pause / Game Over / Win screens
tasks.what: Implement Pause overlay (Resume/Retry/Quit), Game Over (score+stats, Retry/Continue/Quit), and Win (full stats summary, Play Again/Quit) screens wired to the state machine.
tasks.why: Closes the full game loop presentation so every end-state is reachable and navigable per §20.
acceptance: Pause freezes Play and offers Resume/Retry/Quit
Game Over shows score+stats with Retry/Continue(3)/Quit
Win shows full stats summary with Play Again/Quit

tasks.name: HUD
tasks.what: Build the functional Play HUD: red energy bar with cyan shield overlay, ammo + special ammo counts, coins, lives, selected-hero portrait, and checkpoint progress line with markers + hero icon.
tasks.why: Player must read energy/shield/ammo/progress during play; depends only on player state so it stubs early and polishes late.
snippet:
// hud.js
function drawHUD(ctx,p){ /* red energy + cyan shield bar; ammo/special; coins/lives; checkpoint line w/ hero marker */ }
acceptance: Energy bar shows red fill + cyan shield overlay
Ammo, special ammo, coins, lives display live
Checkpoint line shows markers 1-1..1-4 and hero position along level length
